name: onwatch
description: AI quota tracking in your status bar - Anthropic, Codex, Copilot, Gemini and more, powered by the onWatch daemon

onwatch.daemonUrl.markdownDescription: Full base URL of the onWatch daemon, for example `http://127.0.0.1:9211` or `http://host:9211/onwatch` when the daemon runs behind a base path. Leave empty to auto-discover: `~/.onwatch/port`, then the `ONWATCH_PORT` environment variable, then port `9211` on `127.0.0.1`.

enumDescriptions: One status bar item showing the tightest quota across all visible providers.
One status bar item per visible provider.
onwatch.statusBar.mode.markdownDescription: How quotas are laid out in the status bar.

enumDescriptions: Always show the status bar item(s).
Show only when a visible provider is at warning or worse, or when the daemon is unreachable.
Never show anything in the status bar. Commands still work.
onwatch.statusBar.visibility.markdownDescription: When the status bar item(s) are shown.

enumDescriptions: Open the dashboard and quick view inside VS Code with Simple Browser (falls back to the external browser if unavailable).
Always open in the system browser.
onwatch.openIn.markdownDescription: Where clicking the status bar item, or running `onWatch: Open Dashboard`, opens pages.

onwatch.followDaemonSettings.markdownDescription: Use the daemon's menubar preferences (`Settings > Menubar` in the dashboard) for provider visibility, provider order, warning and critical thresholds, and refresh cadence. Any of `#onwatch.providers#`, `#onwatch.pollIntervalSeconds#`, `#onwatch.thresholds.warningPercent#` or `#onwatch.thresholds.criticalPercent#` overrides the daemon value only when you set it explicitly. When off, only the extension settings are used.

onwatch.providers.markdownDescription: Provider IDs to show, in order (for example `["anthropic", "codex", "copilot"]`; profile-scoped IDs like `codex:work` are accepted). Empty means all providers the daemon reports as visible.

onwatch.pollIntervalSeconds.markdownDescription: How often to poll the daemon, in seconds (minimum 10). Used as a fallback only: when `#onwatch.followDaemonSettings#` is on, the daemon's `refresh_seconds` wins unless you set this explicitly.

onwatch.thresholds.warningPercent.markdownDescription: Percent used at which a quota turns to the warning color. Only used for the extension's own severity decisions when not following daemon settings (or when set explicitly); otherwise the daemon's computed status is trusted.

onwatch.thresholds.criticalPercent.markdownDescription: Percent used at which a quota turns to the critical color. Only used for the extension's own severity decisions when not following daemon settings (or when set explicitly); otherwise the daemon's computed status is trusted.

enumDescriptions: Show a notification when a quota enters the critical range.
Show a notification when a quota enters the warning or the critical range.
onwatch.notify.markdownDescription: Show a non-modal warning notification when a quota crosses a threshold. Fires once per provider, quota and reset window - never repeatedly while the quota stays there.

onwatch.auth.username.markdownDescription: Username for HTTP Basic auth when the daemon has authentication enabled. The password is stored in VS Code's secret storage; set it with `onWatch: Set Daemon Credentials`. Not needed for a daemon on `127.0.0.1`.
